여러 서비스의 화면을 같은 컴포넌트로 만들어요: Build every service's screens from the same components
<strong>Foundations</strong>색, 글자, 간격처럼: FoundationsBasic rules for every screen, such as color, text and spacing
<strong>Components</strong>버튼, 입력창처럼 가져다: ComponentsScreen elements you reuse, such as buttons and inputs
<strong>Guides</strong>기본으로 드리는 안이에요. 서비: GuidesThese are starting points. Adapt them freely to fit your service.
사용성 원칙과 화면 형태, 요소 배치 기준: Usability principles, screen types and how to place elements
말투와 용어, 버튼·오류·안내 문구: Tone, terms, and copy for buttons, errors and notices
모션과 상태 전환, 열림·닫힘·검증 동작: Motion, state changes, and open, close and validation behavior
텍스트, 숫자, 날짜 표기와 다국어 대응: Writing text, numbers and dates, and supporting multiple languages
색 대비, 포커스, 키보드, 스크린리더 규칙: Rules for color contrast, focus, keyboard and screen readers
바이브코딩을 하는 모든 현업 분들이 자유롭게 가져다 쓸 수 있도록 만들었: Built so anyone on the business side who vibe-codes can pick it up freely.
디자인 시스템은 서비스 화면을 만들 때 함께 쓰는 공통 컴포넌트 모음이에: A design system is a shared set of components for making service screens. Like LEGO bricks, buttons, inputs, colors and text sizes are defined once, and every service uses the same bricks. That way every service looks alike and works the same way.
이 페이지는 그 컴포넌트를 한곳에 모아 둔 안내서예요. 코드를 몰라도 편: This page gathers those components in one place. You don't need to know code — feel free to look around.
AI로 프로젝트에 적용하기: Apply it to your project with AI
아래 프롬프트를 복사해서 쓰고 있는 AI에게 붙여 넣으세요. AI가 프로: Copy the prompt below and paste it into the AI you use. The AI picks the right way to connect it to your project. You only need to do this once per project.
Start your request to the AI with "Using the design system". The more you say about what goes on the screen, the more accurate the result.
<strong>새 화면 만들기</strong> \"디자인 시스템 써서 로: New screen "Using the design system, build a sign-in screen. Ask for an employee ID and password, and show an error below the field if they're wrong"
<strong>목록 화면</strong> \"디자인 시스템 써서 신청 내: List screen "Using the design system, build a list of requests. Add a status filter, search and pagination"
<strong>입력 폼</strong> \"디자인 시스템 써서 출장 신청: Input form "Using the design system, build a business trip request form. Pick dates from a calendar and mark the required fields"
<strong>확인 창</strong> \"디자인 시스템 써서 삭제 버튼: Confirmation "Using the design system, show a confirmation dialog that asks whether to really delete when the delete button is pressed"
<strong>빈 화면과 로딩</strong> \"디자인 시스템 써서 목: Empty and loading states "Using the design system, add a message for when the list is empty and placeholders to show while it loads"
<strong>기존 화면 정리</strong> \"이 화면을 디자인 시스: Tidy up an existing screen "Update this screen to match the design system. Keep the behavior and change only the colors, spacing and buttons"
<strong>점검하기</strong> \"디자인 시스템 기준으로 이 화: Review "Review this screen against the design system. Check dark mode, phone width and keyboard use too"
<strong>새 버전 받기</strong> dds 플러그인을 설치하고: Get a new version Install the dds plugin and type "/dds:update" or "Update the design system to the new version". It asks before overwriting files we changed
<strong>화면을 기획할 때</strong> 쓸 수 있는 버튼과 입력: When planning a screen, see which buttons and inputs are available.
<strong>시안을 확인할 때</strong> 색과 글자 크기가 기준과: When reviewing a mockup, check that colors and text sizes match the standard.
<strong>개발자와 이야기할 때</strong> 여기 있는 이름으로: When talking with developers, use the names here so everyone pictures the same thing. For example, say Dialog instead of "popup window".
Pick an item in the left menu. On a phone, tap the menu button at the top to open it.
<strong>메뉴 검색</strong>에 \"버튼\", \"달력\",: Menu search also finds items by plain words like "button", "calendar" or "date".
<strong>예시는 직접 눌러 보세요.</strong> 버튼을 누르거나: Try the examples. Pressing buttons or opening windows here has no effect on real services.
<strong>달 모양 버튼</strong>을 누르면 어두운 화면에서 어: Press the moon button to see how things look on a dark screen. Press the sun button to return to the light screen.
<strong>Foundations</strong>: 화면의 기본 규칙이: Foundations: the basic rules of a screen — color, text size and spacing that every screen shares.
<strong>Components</strong>: 화면을 이루는 컴포넌: Components: the pieces that make up a screen — buttons, inputs, dialogs and other pieces you actually use.
<strong>Guides</strong>: UX, 문구, 인터랙션, 접: Guides: starting points for UX, copy, interaction and accessibility. They can differ by service, so feel free to adapt them.
<strong>토큰</strong>: 색이나 여백에 붙인 이름표예요. 이: Token: a name tag attached to a color or spacing value. Change the value behind the tag, and every screen that uses it changes at once.
<strong>컴포넌트</strong>: 버튼이나 입력창처럼 여러 화면에: Component: a screen element reused across screens, such as a button or an input.
<strong>명세</strong>: 컴포넌트의 쓰임과 규칙을 적은 설명: Spec: a guide to a component's use and rules. Open it from the Spec link next to each item's title.
여기에 없는 컴포넌트가 필요하다면: If you need a component that isn't here
Build it in your project. No approval is needed. Just keep the colors and spacing rules from here, so it fits with the other screens.
<a href=\"README.md\">README.md</a>부터 읽어: Start with README.md. It covers how to bring the system into a project and the implementation rules.
회사 로고 파일이다. 서비스 화면과 문서에는 여기 있는 파일을 그대로 쓴: The company logo files. Use these files as they are in service screens and documents. Don't change their colors or proportions, or redraw them.
대웅제약 로고, 어두운 배경용: Daewoong Pharmaceutical logo, for dark backgrounds
Daewoong 영문 로고, 어두운 배경용: Daewoong English logo, for dark backgrounds
<strong>웹과 문서</strong>는 SVG를 쓴다. 크기를 키워도: Web and documents use SVG. It stays sharp at any size.
<strong>메일이나 슬라이드</strong>처럼 SVG를 넣을 수 없: Where SVG can't be inserted, such as in email or slides, use PNG.
<strong>인쇄와 디자인 작업</strong>은 원본 <a href=: Print and design work uses the source file ci-kor.ai.
<strong>흰색 단색 로고</strong>는 공식 파일이 아니어서 넣: A white single-color logo isn't included because it isn't an official file.
<strong>영문 로고</strong>는 SVG만 있다. 어두운 배경용: The English logo is SVG only. The dark-background version will be replaced when the official file is released.
대표 행동은 Primary 하나로 두고, Secondary로 화면에 변화: Keep one Primary for the main action, and use Secondary to add variety to the screen. Don't use them to show success, warning, error or info.
기본 서체는 <strong>Pretendard</strong>다. 한글·: The default typeface is Pretendard. Its Korean, Latin and numerals are designed as one family, and small text stays crisp, so it works well on screens. It is a free, open typeface, and all text in service screens uses it.
다람쥐 헌 쳇바퀴에 타고파: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
굵기는 세 가지만 쓴다. 본문은 Regular, 강조와 라벨은 Mediu: Use only three weights: Regular for body text, Medium for emphasis and labels, Bold for headings and buttons.
코드나 자릿수를 맞춰야 하는 값에는 고정폭 서체를 쓴다. 따로 내려받지: Use a monospaced typeface for code and values whose digits must line up. It uses the typeface installed on the device, so nothing is downloaded.
웹은 <a href=\"fonts/pretendard.css\">font: On the web, link fonts/pretendard.css before any other styles. Copy the whole fonts/ folder into your project and it works without an external server.
The official files are split by character range, so only the pieces for characters on screen are downloaded.
If the font fails to load, text falls back to the device's default typeface.
지금 들어 있는 파일은 웹용(woff2)이다. 앱에서 쓰려면 TTF나 O: The bundled files are for the web (woff2). For apps, get the TTF or OTF files separately.
SIL Open Font License 1.1을 따르며 사내외 서비스에: It is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 and is free for internal and external services. The full text is in fonts/OFL.txt. Modified files may not use the name Pretendard, so use the files as provided.
화면 요소가 겹칠 때 무엇이 앞에 나올지 정한 규칙이다. 예를 들어 모달: Rules for what comes to the front when screen elements overlap. For example, if you save with a modal open, the result notice (Toast) must appear in front of the modal. In code, don't write numbers directly; use the tokens below (--dw-z-*).
쌓임 순서 토큰. 위쪽 행이 화면 앞쪽이다: Stacking order tokens. Higher rows are closer to the front
<strong>딤과 모달은 같은 값이다.</strong> 같은 값은 나중: Dim and modal share a value. With equal values, the later one comes to the front. Opening a modal over a modal covers the back modal with the dim.
<strong>드롭다운은 모달보다 앞이다.</strong> 모달 안에서: Dropdowns are in front of modals. A Select list opened inside a modal does not hide behind it.
<strong>토스트는 모달보다 앞이다.</strong> 모달이 열려 있: Toasts are in front of modals. The result notice is visible even while a modal is open.
<strong>툴팁은 가장 앞이다.</strong> 사용자가 지금 가리키: Tooltips are frontmost. They describe what the user is pointing at right now.
버튼과 입력 필드는 같은 높이 스케일을 쓴다. 같은 크기는 나란히 놓아도: Buttons and input fields share one height scale. Controls of the same size line up side by side.
Blocked areas are marked with hatching. The content underneath shows through.
상태 색은 <code>-pressed</code> 토큰 짝을 쓴다. 키보: State colors use the -pressed token pair. Keyboard focus looks the same on every element.
Lucide 기반. 색은 감싼 요소의 글자색을 따른다. 환경별 사용법은: Based on Lucide. The color follows the text color of the wrapping element. Usage per platform is in design.md chapter 10.
화면 너비에 따라 배치를 바꾸는 기준점이다. 휴대폰 화면을 기본으로 만들: Points where the layout changes with screen width. Build for phone screens first, and switch to a wider layout each time the width passes a breakpoint. Don't create breakpoints other than the values below.
CSS 미디어 쿼리에는 변수를 쓸 수 없어 숫자를 그대로 적는다. 값의: CSS media queries can't use variables, so write the numbers as they are. The source of truth for the values is breakpoint in tokens.json, and JS reads them from --dw-breakpoint-*.
Rules for screen side margins and content width.
높이 500px 이하 가로 화면은 너비와 무관하게 모바일 배치: Landscape screens 500px tall or less use the mobile layout regardless of width
화면을 세로 칸으로 나눠 요소를 맞추는 기준이다. 칸 수는 화면 너비에: A guide for aligning elements by dividing the screen into vertical columns. The number of columns changes with screen width, and the gap between columns is always 20px. Columns stretch to fit the screen.
Place elements across a span of columns. Choose how many columns to span based on the screen's content.
필터나 목차 + 본문: Filters or table of contents + content
<code>dw-container</code>가 화면 여백과 최대 너비를: dw-container handles the screen margins and max width, and dw-grid handles the columns. The example below follows the actual screen width. For details, see the Grid spec.
넓은 목록·대시보드 최대 너비: Max width for wide lists and dashboards
시안을 그릴 때 쓰는 화면 크기다. 화면 좌우 여백은 <a href=\": Screen sizes to use when drawing mockups. Side margins follow Layout.
iPhone X Safari에 보이는 영역: Visible area in Safari on iPhone X
이미지와 동영상이 들어갈 자리를 비율로 먼저 잡는다. 내용이 늦게 도착해: Reserve the space for images and video by ratio first. Content below doesn't shift even if they arrive late.
Runs a clear action. Use one brand-solid per screen.
조회 조건을 여는 라벨 없는 아이콘 버튼. 시트에서 건 조건 수를 숫자로: A label-less icon button that opens the filters. It shows the number of filters set in the sheet. It is 40px tall, the same as the Select and search box beside it.
Gathers a screen's final actions at the bottom. Use only one primary button.
저장하면 바로 적용돼요: Changes apply as soon as you save
The buttons stay at the bottom of the screen as you scroll the content.
입력 컨트롤에 라벨·필수 표시·설명·오류·글자 수를 붙인다. 아래 폼에서: Adds a label, required mark, description, error and character count to an input control. Press [Submit] in the form below and focus moves to the first field with an error.
Field를 세로로 쌓고 제출 때 검증한다. [저장]은 항상 활성이고,: Stacks Fields vertically and validates on submit. [Save] is always enabled; press it with empty values and focus goes to the first field with an error. Errors clear as soon as they are fixed.
연락처를 숫자와 하이픈으로 입력하세요: Enter a phone number using digits and hyphens
필드 하나에 매이지 않는 사유는 제출 버튼 바로 위의 Callout으로: A reason that isn't tied to one field shows as a Callout right above the submit button.
Orders that have already shipped can't be edited.
Single-line and multi-line text input. Add the label with Field.
오류와 성공은 색만으로 알리지 않고 아이콘과 메시지를 함께 보인다. 값이: Errors and success aren't shown by color alone; an icon and a message appear with them. When there is a value, a clear button appears in the same spot while typing or on hover.
Text Input에 표시·숨김 토글을 붙인다. 토글은 입력값이나 포커스: Adds a show/hide toggle to Text Input. The toggle does not touch the value or focus.
한 테두리 안에 입력과 버튼·글자를 묶는다. 단위나 아이콘만 붙일 때는: Groups an input with buttons or text inside one border. To add just a unit or icon, Text Input's affix and icon are enough.
입력과 별개의 행동을 값 옆에 둔다. 포커스와 오류 테두리는 입력 칸에만: Puts an action that is separate from typing next to the value. Focus and error borders are drawn only on the input.
타이핑 중에는 조회하지 않는다. Enter나 [검색]으로 확정하고, 지우: Typing does not run a search. Confirm with Enter or [Search]; clearing goes straight back to searching everything. The text below shows when a search runs.
여러 보기 중 0개 이상을 고르거나 조건에 동의한다. 선택은 제출할 때: Picks zero or more options, or agrees to a condition. The choice takes effect on submit.
라벨이 길어 여러 줄이 되면 상자는 첫 줄에 맞춘 채로 있고 Root만: When a long label wraps to several lines, the box stays aligned to the first line and only the Root grows downward. The box stays centered on the first line however the text wraps.
서로 배타적인 보기 2–6개 중 하나를 고른다. 화살표 키로 보기를 옮긴: Picks one of 2–6 mutually exclusive options. Arrow keys move between options.
설명이 필요한 보기를 카드로 고른다. 카드 전체가 눌리는 영역이고, 고르: Lets people choose among options that need a description, shown as cards. The whole card is pressable, and choosing one thickens the border and changes the control together.
예약이 확정되면 알려요: We'll let you know when a booking is confirmed
새 공지가 오면 알려요: We'll let you know when there's a new notice
Turns a single setting on or off immediately, without a save button.
연속된 범위에서 값 하나를 끌어서 고른다. 현재 값은 옆에 글자로 함께: Drag to pick one value in a continuous range. The current value is also shown as text beside it.
7개 이상의 보기 중 하나, 또는 여러 개를 고르는 드롭다운. 포커스는: A dropdown for picking one or more of 7 or more options. Focus stays on the Trigger; arrow keys and typing highlight options.
묶음 · 설명 · 앞 아이콘 · 비활성 보기: Groups · descriptions · leading icons · disabled options
오류 (보기를 고르면 해제): Error (cleared when you pick an option)
이름이 아주 길어서 한 줄에 다 들어가지 않는 보기는 말줄임표로 잘려 나: An option whose name is so long that it can't fit on one line must be cut off with an ellipsis
긴 목록 (스크롤) · 아래 공간이 부족하면 위로 열림: Long list (scrolls) · opens upward when there isn't enough room below
상태 아이콘 · 앞 아이콘 · 긴 값: Status icon · leading icon · long value
Long values are truncated on one line.
서울특별시 강남구 테헤란로 일대의 지점을 모두 포함한 권역: Area covering every branch around Teheran-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul
보기마다 앞에 체크박스가 있어 열면 무엇을 골랐는지 바로 보인다. 고를: Every option has a checkbox in front, so opening the list shows at once what is picked. The list stays open after each pick, and picked values stack up as chips. To remove one, press it again in the list. Jeju in Many picked is picked and locked.
여러 개를 고를 수 있어요: You can pick more than one
보기가 많은 드롭다운을 글자로 좁혀 고른다. Combobox의 선택 전용: Narrows a dropdown with many options by typing, then picks one. It is the select-only form of Combobox. Matching text is highlighted, empty means all, and clearing resets it.
글자를 쳐서 목록을 좁히고 그중 하나를 고른다. 입력은 Text Inpu: Type to narrow a list, then pick one item. The input is Text Input and the list is Select, used as they are. A value is set only when you pick from the list.
async — 입력하면 서버에서 찾는다: async — searches the server as you type
이 예시는 네트워크 없이 <code>dw:combobox-search</: This example fakes server latency with dw:combobox-search, without a network. Try "Kim" or "Park". Type "error" to make it fail, or "none" to get no results. It searches when you pause after the first two characters.
달력 면이다. 화면에 늘 펴 두고 날짜나 기간을 고를 때 쓴다. 입력 칸: A calendar surface. Keep it open on screen to pick a date or a range. For one that opens from an input, use Date Picker.
입력 칸을 눌러 달력을 열고 날짜 하나를 고른다. 768px 미만에서는: Press the input to open a calendar and pick one date. Below 768px it opens as a Bottom Sheet. The value is submitted as yyyy-mm-dd and shown on screen as "May 20, 2026 (Wed)".
정해진 시간 슬롯 중 하나를 고르는 네이티브 select다. 슬롯 간격과: A native select for picking one of a set of time slots. The screen decides the slot interval and range. This example runs 09:00–18:30 in 30-minute steps.
분 단위까지 자유롭게 입력하는 시간 칸이다. 네이티브 <code>inpu: A time field for entering any time down to the minute. It is a native input[type=time], so on mobile the device's time picker opens.
Picks one of 2–5 options to switch how the same screen is viewed right away.
여러 조건을 모아 한 번에 조회하는 시트. 768px 미만은 Bottom: A sheet that collects several filters and applies them at once. It opens as a Bottom Sheet below 768px and a Side Sheet above. Closing without applying discards the input, and Reset only clears the input. Pick filters and apply to see tags appear.
Narrow by order status and delivery method.
시트에서 건 조건만 필터 줄 아래에 지우기 아이콘이 있는 Chip으로 남: Only the filters set in the sheet stay below the filter row, as Chips with a clear icon. Pressing one removes just that filter; with no filters, the row disappears.
요청 사항: 문 앞에 두고 벨은 누르지 말아 주세요. 부재 시 경비실에: Remove filter Request: Leave it at the door and please don't ring the bell. If no one is home, leave it with the security office
